initial.name: ask_user_question

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

initial.name: subagent
initial.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs.

initial.name: subagent_fork
initial.description: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation: a child agent seeded with all completed turns so far (it does not see the current in-flight turn). Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.

initial.name: todo_update
initial.description: Update one existing task without resending the list; task must match its full text. Use status completed with start_next true to finish that task and start the first pending task when no other task is in progress. Repeating an already completed task does not advance again. Use todo_write to add, rename, remove, or reorder tasks. While work remains, keep the todos being worked on `in_progress`, several only when work runs in parallel. After each stage, verify its actual result and immediately update the completed task and the work now in progress. Keep unfinished or failed work pending or in_progress; do not wait until final delivery to update all tasks at once. Generation success does not complete editing, quality checks, or delivery.

task.description: Exact content of the existing task; surrounding whitespace is ignored.

status.description: Actual task state: pending, in_progress, or completed.

start_next.description: Only with completed: on a new completion, start the first pending task if no task remains in_progress.

initial.name: todo_write
initial.description: Record and update a task list to plan multi-step work and show progress; skip it for trivial single-step tasks. Add one todo per concrete step before you start. Use this tool to create or revise the whole plan; use todo_update for individual status changes. While work remains, keep the todos being worked on `in_progress`, several only when work runs in parallel. After each stage, verify its actual result and immediately update the completed task and the work now in progress. Keep unfinished or failed work pending or in_progress; do not wait until final delivery to update all tasks at once. Generation success does not complete editing, quality checks, or delivery.

todos.description: The COMPLETE task list, replacing any previous list.

content.description: What the task is — a short imperative line.

initial.name: tool_context
initial.description: Manage tool definitions for your current session. status lists loaded and pinned tools. load exposes exact tools for this session. pin also marks them as preferred; a configured preference provider can retain them for future sessions. release removes session loading and the preference; unpin removes only the preference and keeps currently loaded tools. Constant base tools, tool_search and tool_context cannot be released. Changes apply to your next model request; historical definitions and results remain in conversation history. Search can load a released tool again. This does not grant permissions or change other agents.

operation.description: Read status, load for this session, pin preferred tools, release, or cancel a preference.

tools.description: Exact tool names; required for changes. Use tool_search to find names.

initial.name: tool_search
initial.description: Find authorized tools not loaded upfront by task or exact name; matching full definitions load next step. With no arguments, list capability groups without loading tools. Supply capability alone to browse and load a group, or combine it with query to narrow a search. A category query with no matches also searches globally. If results are omitted, use next_offset or narrow the query. No match does not establish that a capability is unavailable. Search does not execute tools.

query.description: Task description or exact tool name; supports Chinese and English. Omit both query and capability to list capabilities.

capability.description: Optional capability id from the directory. Omit to search across groups.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset for the same query or capability; use next_offset from an earlier result. Defaults to zero.

limit.description: Maximum matching tools to load, from 1 to 8; defaults to 8.

initial.name: update_goal
initial.description: Update the current goal.

revision.description: Exact positive revision returned by get_goal.

action.description: edit, pause, and resume require a direct top-level human request. complete and blocked are also allowed during an automatic continuation of this goal; blocked is rejected before the configured minimum round count. wait yields the foreground while keeping the goal active; resume on user input, watched job output, or a timer.

objective.description: Replacement objective; valid only with action edit.

max_goal_rounds.description: Replacement cap; valid only with action edit.

blocked_reason.description: Required only with action blocked: the concrete condition that persisted across rounds and blocks progress.

wait_reason.description: With action wait: describe what new information or event is needed.

wake_after_seconds.description: With action wait: optional positive whole seconds before continuing.

job_id.description: With action wait: optional owned job to watch for new output or settlement.

reason.description: close或reopen的可选原因；不改变未查看、未记录帧。

episode.description: 首次scan时标记集号；省略则使用实际视频路径。

fresh_scan.description: 仅在scan时使用；显式新建审看并重新扫描，旧观察留在会话历史中，新帧须重新查看和记录。

method.description: 默认scan；next查看下一批，revisit重显已记录原图，observe逐图记录，events保存动作事件表；status读取进度，timeline并列时间线，compare对照当前稿，metadata只读元数据。close结束当前来源后续跟进，不补记图片；reopen校验来源后恢复，不重新扫描。

timeline_end_seconds.description: timeline可选的来源结束秒数；局部材料不代表整集已核对。省略则到本集结尾。

frame_ids.description: revisit需要重看的已记录frame_id，数量不超过当前批上限；返回缓存原图及原观察，不重新抽帧、不重置记录。

timestamps_seconds.description: scan可选的补看来源秒数，最多256项且0≤t<真实视频时长；合入常规扫描，保留同版本已有帧ID，新帧仍须next实际看图并observe，不能凭时间补记完成。

draft_path.description: compare使用的本集已保存UTF-8剧本路径；返回完整正文与时间顺序观察记录，不写稿、不自动审核。Word请使用其对应文本源稿。

observations.description: observe时按实际返回的frame_id逐图记录；不能用“已查看”或“同上”代替内容。

visible.description: 具体可见人物、位置、动作、神态或道具；至少8个字符。

change.description: 与邻近画面的变化；无变化也需据实说明。

uncertainty.description: 需要补看前后画面才能澄清的具体疑点；没有时可省略。填写具体疑点会安排前后补帧。

changes.name: subagent
changes.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

changes.name: subagent_fork
changes.description: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation: a child agent seeded with all completed turns so far (it does not see the current in-flight turn). Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.

changes.name: todo_update
changes.description: Update one existing task without resending the list; task must match its full text. Use status completed with start_next true to finish that task and start the first pending task when no other task is in progress. Repeating an already completed task does not advance again. Use todo_write to add, rename, remove, or reorder tasks. While work remains, keep the todos being worked on `in_progress`, several only when work runs in parallel. After each stage, verify its actual result and immediately update the completed task and the work now in progress. Keep unfinished or failed work pending or in_progress; do not wait until final delivery to update all tasks at once. Generation success does not complete editing, quality checks, or delivery.

task.description: Exact content of the existing task; surrounding whitespace is ignored.

status.description: Actual task state: pending, in_progress, or completed.

start_next.description: Only with completed: on a new completion, start the first pending task if no task remains in_progress.

changes.name: todo_write
changes.description: Record and update a task list to plan multi-step work and show progress; skip it for trivial single-step tasks. Add one todo per concrete step before you start. Use this tool to create or revise the whole plan; use todo_update for individual status changes. While work remains, keep the todos being worked on `in_progress`, several only when work runs in parallel. After each stage, verify its actual result and immediately update the completed task and the work now in progress. Keep unfinished or failed work pending or in_progress; do not wait until final delivery to update all tasks at once. Generation success does not complete editing, quality checks, or delivery.

todos.description: The COMPLETE task list, replacing any previous list.

content.description: What the task is — a short imperative line.

changes.name: tool_context

Constant base tools, tool_search and tool_context cannot be released. Changes apply to your next model request; historical definitions and results remain in conversation history. Search can load a released tool again. This does not grant permissions or change other agents.

operation.description: Read status, load for this session, pin preferred tools, release, or cancel a preference.

tools.description: Exact tool names; required for changes. Use tool_search to find names.

changes.name: tool_search
changes.description: Find authorized tools not loaded upfront by task or exact name; matching full definitions load next step. With no arguments, list capability groups without loading tools. Supply capability alone to browse and load a group, or combine it with query to narrow a search. A category query with no matches also searches globally. If results are omitted, use next_offset or narrow the query. No match does not establish that a capability is unavailable. Search does not execute tools.

query.description: Task description or exact tool name; supports Chinese and English. Omit both query and capability to list capabilities.

capability.description: Optional capability id from the directory. Omit to search across groups.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset for the same query or capability; use next_offset from an earlier result. Defaults to zero.

limit.description: Maximum matching tools to load, from 1 to 8; defaults to 8.

changes.description: Read Lvpaopao rankings, search titles and inspect actual catalogs in a qualified local WeChat runtime. rankings returns current board labels, source positions and identities; page with the same boardType, count and returned coldStartTime. engagement accepts an exact title or selected source IDs and reads all catalog episodes, returning likes, comments, all-user recommendations and shares with episode rows and observation times. Optional episodeNo selects one episode. Totals are episode sums, not distinct people; missing counts remain null with coverage and knownTotals. It never likes, comments, recommends, shares or downloads. download_series accepts a title (selection-required when ambiguous) or selected source IDs. mode defaults to wait; background returns series-queued with owned data.seriesTask.id/state/jobId and continues after the tool returns. That outer ID differs from data.series.taskId. Repeating download_series refreshes the catalog and rechecks saved files. series_status is local-only: supply either seriesTaskId alone or source IDs with outputDir. series_resume and series_cancel accept only seriesTaskId and only its original live Session can control it. Resume rechecks current file permission and saved receipts, explicitly recovers the shared connection through status, then reconciles unknown episodes with their original download_status keys before safe same-key retries. Restart marks interrupted tasks without replay; use series_resume explicitly. A missing previously used manifest blocks recovery. Background tasks can report waiting_user or waiting_source; queued does not establish completion. Only account-playable episodes are downloaded; no purchases, ads or unlocks. Completion requires every actual catalog episode and verified local files; unknown catalog coverage stays incomplete. Open/reopen Lvpaopao when status reports waiting-target. Results do not grant reuse rights.
